title: Veined hands, Piku and Tony, and a photo of Snooks Eaglin
summary: Remarks on a man's veins, a failed attempt to place Tony, and an introduction to a photo of Snooks Eaglin.

blocks.x: What a face on this one.
He's got a wild face man. I've never seen anybody with him.
Quite a few guys in New Orleans have all them veins on your hands.
Serpentine veins they call them, they're like snakes.
That's for thinking I guess. Shrink up your skull. Is Piku and his daughter? Mm-hmm. Is Tony still his old age again?
No, she's a man, a woman. Who he married?
Oh, oh, oh. Tony, I don't know.
That's a guy called Snooks Eaglin. We'll play you a little record by here in a minute. What time you gotta leave, Danny? We'll leave about a quarter after nine. It's about that time now.
After nine, yeah? I gotta start splitting down it.
